title: Pointing Stability
definition: Pointing stability describes how pointing changes during a stated interval or within a stated frequency band. It is a property of a time history and its measurement chain, so a stability value needs the line of sight or axis, interval, sample and filter treatment, statistic, confidence and operating condition.[^1][^2] It does not replace [[Pointing Accuracy]], which describes closeness to a target or reference.[^1][^2]
